title: 米約高架橋
subcategoryTitle: 拱橋、高架橋與跨海通道
subcategoryTitleEn: Arch bridges, viaducts and sea crossings
summary: 米約高架橋以七座混凝土高墩、七座鋼塔與 2,460 公尺連續鋼箱梁跨越法國塔恩河谷，最高墩約 245 公尺、塔頂高 343 公尺。本課從河谷高空風與多跨斜張體系的勁度問題出發，分析雙肢橋墩、正交異性鋼箱梁與 154 根單股斜索，再拆解由兩岸頂推、經臨時鋼墩把跨徑減半的施工法與合龍，最後談斜索監測、載重試驗、鋼橋面疲勞與特許經營期的維護。
summaryEn: The Millau Viaduct crosses the Tarn valley in France on seven concrete piers, seven steel pylons and a 2,460 m continuous steel box deck, with the tallest pier about 245 m and the pylon tops at 343 m. The course starts with high-level valley wind and the stiffness problem of multi-span cable-stayed bridges, examines split-shaft piers, the orthotropic steel box and 154 monostrand stays, then unpacks launching from both abutments over temporary towers that halve the spans and the closure, ending with stay monitoring, load testing, deck fatigue and maintenance through the concession.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、吊裝或張拉作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

stages.title: 工程背景、荷載與結構系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「塔恩河谷高空風與行車安全」與「多跨斜張體系與橋墩勁度」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Valley wind and traffic safety" and "Multi-span stays and pier stiffness": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 塔恩河谷高空風與行車安全：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Valley wind and traffic safety: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「橋面風屏」如何影響米約高架橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Deck wind screens” governs force, deformation or durability in “Millau Viaduct”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 米約高架橋的橋面距塔恩河最高約 270 公尺，河谷地形使強風加速並伴隨陣風，風荷載同時作用在鋼箱梁、橋墩、鋼塔與 154 根斜索上。對結構而言，橫向風力經箱梁傳到支承與墩頂，再由高墩以彎矩傳到基礎；對使用者而言，側風會讓高車身車輛偏移或傾覆，因此橋面兩側設置風屏，以降低車道上的風速。風屏本身卻增加了箱梁的受風面積與阻力，必須在風洞試驗中同時評估行車舒適與結構風載的取捨。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「橋面風屏」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The Millau deck stands up to about 270 m above the Tarn, and the valley topography accelerates strong winds and gusts that act at once on the steel box girder, piers, pylons and 154 stays. Structurally, lateral wind on the deck passes through bearings to the pier heads and then down the tall piers as bending to the foundations; for users, crosswinds push or overturn high-sided vehicles, so wind screens line both deck edges to cut wind speed over the lanes. The screens add exposed area and drag to the girder, so wind-tunnel testing must weigh traffic comfort against structural wind load. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Deck wind screens” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：風壓 q = ½ρV²。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Wind pressure q = ½ρV².
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「風屏只是保護駕駛的附屬設施，不會影響主結構受力。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Wind screens are just driver-protection fittings and do not affect the main structure." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「橋面風屏」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Deck wind screens”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: The Millau deck stands up to about 270 m above the Tarn, and the valley topography accelerates strong winds and gusts that act at once on the steel box girder, piers, pylons and 154 stays. Structurally, lateral wind on the deck passes through bearings to the pier heads and then down the tall piers as bending to the foundations; for users, crosswinds push or overturn high-sided vehicles, so wind screens line both deck edges to cut wind speed over the lanes.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：風屏只是保護駕駛的附屬設施，不會影響主結構受力。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Wind screens are just driver-protection fittings and do not affect the main structure. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「米約高架橋」的「塔恩河谷高空風與行車安全：機制與傳力路徑」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出載重來源、構件、接點與支承的傳力邊界，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「跨河橋梁試載日」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與幾何版本、支承條件、荷載方向與獨立位移紀錄的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Valley wind and traffic safety: mechanism and load path” in “Millau Viaduct”. Draw the load, member, connection and support load paths; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Bridge proof-test day” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for geometry revision, supports, load direction and independent displacement records, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

quiz.question: 關於「塔恩河谷高空風與行車安全」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Valley wind and traffic safety" is correct?
options: 風屏只是保護駕駛的附屬設施，不會影響主結構受力。
米約高架橋的橋面距塔恩河最高約 270 公尺，河谷地形使強風加速並伴隨陣風，風荷載同時作用在鋼箱梁、橋墩、鋼塔與 154 根斜索上。
橋墩越粗越剛，多跨斜張橋就越安全。
optionsEn: Wind screens are just driver-protection fittings and do not affect the main structure.
The Millau deck stands up to about 270 m above the Tarn, and the valley topography accelerates strong winds and gusts that act at once on the steel box girder, piers, pylons and 154 stays.
The thicker and stiffer the piers, the safer a multi-span cable-stayed bridge becomes.
quiz.explanation: 米約高架橋的橋面距塔恩河最高約 270 公尺，河谷地形使強風加速並伴隨陣風，風荷載同時作用在鋼箱梁、橋墩、鋼塔與 154 根斜索上。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The Millau deck stands up to about 270 m above the Tarn, and the valley topography accelerates strong winds and gusts that act at once on the steel box girder, piers, pylons and 154 stays. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 塔恩河谷高空風與行車安全：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Valley wind and traffic safety: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「橋面風屏」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Deck wind screens” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：風壓 q = ½ρV²。取 V = 50 m/s、ρ = 1.225 kg/m³，q = 0.5×1.225×50² ≈ 1,531 Pa。箱梁深 4.2 m 加上風屏等效高度共 7.2 m、阻力係數 C_D = 1.3，每公尺橫向力 = 1,531×1.3×7.2 ≈ 14.3 kN/m；一個 342 m 跨約 4,900 kN。風速、等效高度與 C_D 為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Wind pressure q = ½ρV². With V = 50 m/s and ρ = 1.225 kg/m³, q = 0.5×1.225×50² ≈ 1,531 Pa. Taking the 4.2 m box plus screens as an equivalent 7.2 m height with C_D = 1.3, the lateral force is 1,531×1.3×7.2 ≈ 14.3 kN/m, about 4,900 kN on one 342 m span. Wind speed, equivalent height and C_D are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以斷面模型風洞試驗量測有無風屏時的阻力、升力與力矩係數，並以全橋氣動彈性模型或分析確認抖振反應；營運期以橋面風速計記錄實際風速與陣風因子，與設計風況比較，並作為交通限制的依據。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure drag, lift and moment coefficients with and without screens in sectional wind-tunnel tests, and confirm buffeting response with a full aeroelastic model or analysis; in service, deck anemometers record actual mean speeds and gust factors for comparison with design winds and as the basis for traffic restrictions.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 風壓 q = ½ρV²。取 V = 50 m/s、ρ = 1.225 kg/m³，q = 0.5×1.225×50² ≈ 1,531 Pa。箱梁深 4.2 m 加上風屏等效高度共 7.2 m、阻力係數 C_D = 1.3，每公尺橫向力 = 1,531×1.3×7.2 ≈ 14.3 kN/m；一個 342 m 跨約 4,900 kN。風速、等效高度與 C_D 為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Wind pressure q = ½ρV². With V = 50 m/s and ρ = 1.225 kg/m³, q = 0.5×1.225×50² ≈ 1,531 Pa. Taking the 4.2 m box plus screens as an equivalent 7.2 m height with C_D = 1.3, the lateral force is 1,531×1.3×7.2 ≈ 14.3 kN/m, about 4,900 kN on one 342 m span. Wind speed, equivalent height and C_D are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「塔恩河谷高空風與行車安全」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Valley wind and traffic safety", which statement holds?
options: 斜索容許應力越高越好，只要強度夠就不必考慮疲勞。
兩段鋼梁對準後焊起來就完成合龍，之後的施工順序不影響結果。
風壓 q = ½ρV²。
optionsEn: The higher the allowable stay stress the better; fatigue need not be checked if strength is sufficient.
Once the two deck ends are aligned and welded, closure is done and later sequence does not matter.
Wind pressure q = ½ρV².
quiz.explanation: 風壓 q = ½ρV²。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Wind pressure q = ½ρV². Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 塔恩河谷高空風與行車安全：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Valley wind and traffic safety: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「橋面風屏」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Deck wind screens” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以斷面模型風洞試驗量測有無風屏時的阻力、升力與力矩係數，並以全橋氣動彈性模型或分析確認抖振反應；營運期以橋面風速計記錄實際風速與陣風因子，與設計風況比較，並作為交通限制的依據。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure drag, lift and moment coefficients with and without screens in sectional wind-tunnel tests, and confirm buffeting response with a full aeroelastic model or analysis; in service, deck anemometers record actual mean speeds and gust factors for comparison with design winds and as the basis for traffic restrictions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：風屏的孔隙率、高度與固定方式應與結構設計同一批風洞試驗決定，更換或改型須經結構工程師重新檢核；交通管理單位應依橋面實測風速建立分級限制程序並定期檢討。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Screen porosity, height and fixing should be fixed in the same wind-tunnel campaign as the structure, and any replacement or redesign re-checked by the structural engineer; the operator should base staged traffic restrictions on measured deck wind speeds and review them periodically.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若只以風屏改善行車條件而未把風屏阻力納入結構設計，強風下橋墩彎矩與支承橫向力會超出預期；反之若風屏孔隙設計不當，車道風速降不下來，強風時只能封橋，交通可靠度大打折扣。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Adding screens for traffic without including their drag in structural design lets pier moments and lateral bearing forces exceed predictions in storms; conversely, poorly designed screen porosity fails to reduce lane wind speeds, forcing closures in strong winds and undermining reliability. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以斷面模型風洞試驗量測有無風屏時的阻力、升力與力矩係數，並以全橋氣動彈性模型或分析確認抖振反應；營運期以橋面風速計記錄實際風速與陣風因子，與設計風況比較，並作為交通限制的依據。
knowledge.textEn: Measure drag, lift and moment coefficients with and without screens in sectional wind-tunnel tests, and confirm buffeting response with a full aeroelastic model or analysis; in service, deck anemometers record actual mean speeds and gust factors for comparison with design winds and as the basis for traffic restrictions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 風屏的孔隙率、高度與固定方式應與結構設計同一批風洞試驗決定，更換或改型須經結構工程師重新檢核；交通管理單位應依橋面實測風速建立分級限制程序並定期檢討。
knowledge.textEn: Screen porosity, height and fixing should be fixed in the same wind-tunnel campaign as the structure, and any replacement or redesign re-checked by the structural engineer; the operator should base staged traffic restrictions on measured deck wind speeds and review them periodically.

quiz.question: 要驗證「塔恩河谷高空風與行車安全」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Valley wind and traffic safety"?
options: 以斷面模型風洞試驗量測有無風屏時的阻力、升力與力矩係數，並以全橋氣動彈性模型或分析確認抖振反應。
量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
載重試驗只要量跨中撓度就能證明多跨斜張橋的性能。
optionsEn: Measure drag, lift and moment coefficients with and without screens in sectional wind-tunnel tests, and confirm buffeting response with a full aeroelastic model or analysis.
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Measuring mid-span deflection alone proves the performance of a multi-span cable-stayed bridge.
quiz.explanation: 以斷面模型風洞試驗量測有無風屏時的阻力、升力與力矩係數，並以全橋氣動彈性模型或分析確認抖振反應；營運期以橋面風速計記錄實際風速與陣風因子，與設計風況比較，並作為交通限制的依據。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure drag, lift and moment coefficients with and without screens in sectional wind-tunnel tests, and confirm buffeting response with a full aeroelastic model or analysis; in service, deck anemometers record actual mean speeds and gust factors for comparison with design winds and as the basis for traffic restrictions. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 塔恩河谷高空風與行車安全：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Valley wind and traffic safety: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「橋面風屏」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Deck wind screens” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若只以風屏改善行車條件而未把風屏阻力納入結構設計，強風下橋墩彎矩與支承橫向力會超出預期；反之若風屏孔隙設計不當，車道風速降不下來，強風時只能封橋，交通可靠度大打折扣。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Adding screens for traffic without including their drag in structural design lets pier moments and lateral bearing forces exceed predictions in storms; conversely, poorly designed screen porosity fails to reduce lane wind speeds, forcing closures in strong winds and undermining reliability. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：風屏本身卻增加了箱梁的受風面積與阻力，必須在風洞試驗中同時評估行車舒適與結構風載的取捨。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The screens add exposed area and drag to the girder, so wind-tunnel testing must weigh traffic comfort against structural wind load.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「風屏只是保護駕駛的附屬設施，不會影響主結構受力。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Wind screens are just driver-protection fittings and do not affect the main structure." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.text: 若只以風屏改善行車條件而未把風屏阻力納入結構設計，強風下橋墩彎矩與支承橫向力會超出預期；反之若風屏孔隙設計不當，車道風速降不下來，強風時只能封橋，交通可靠度大打折扣。

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「塔恩河谷高空風與行車安全」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Valley wind and traffic safety" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
若只以風屏改善行車條件而未把風屏阻力納入結構設計，強風下橋墩彎矩與支承橫向力會超出預期。
橋墩越粗越剛，多跨斜張橋就越安全。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Adding screens for traffic without including their drag in structural design lets pier moments and lateral bearing forces exceed predictions in storms.
The thicker and stiffer the piers, the safer a multi-span cable-stayed bridge becomes.
quiz.explanation: 若只以風屏改善行車條件而未把風屏阻力納入結構設計，強風下橋墩彎矩與支承橫向力會超出預期；反之若風屏孔隙設計不當，車道風速降不下來，強風時只能封橋，交通可靠度大打折扣。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Adding screens for traffic without including their drag in structural design lets pier moments and lateral bearing forces exceed predictions in storms; conversely, poorly designed screen porosity fails to reduce lane wind speeds, forcing closures in strong winds and undermining reliability. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 多跨斜張體系與橋墩勁度：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Multi-span stays and pier stiffness: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「雙肢橋墩上段」如何影響米約高架橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Split upper pier shafts” governs force, deformation or durability in “Millau Viaduct”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 一般斜張橋靠錨碇跨把背索固定在地面，塔頂水平位移受控；米約有六個 342 公尺主跨連續排列，中間各塔沒有錨碇跨，活載只放在某一跨時，塔頂會被拉向受載跨，箱梁與橋墩必須提供勁度抵抗這種不對稱變形。另一方面，長 2,460 公尺的連續鋼梁隨溫度伸縮，墩頂被強迫水平位移，若橋墩太剛就會產生很大的彎矩。設計者的解法是讓每座墩在上部約 90 公尺分成兩肢：兩肢組成的框架對不對稱活載提供彎曲勁度，單肢較細又能柔和地跟隨梁體伸縮。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「雙肢橋墩上段」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A conventional cable-stayed bridge ties its back stays to the ground through anchor spans, limiting tower-top sway; Millau has six 342 m main spans in a row, so the inner pylons have no anchor spans, and live load on one span pulls the pylon tops toward it, requiring the deck and piers to resist this unbalanced deformation. At the same time the 2,460 m continuous steel deck expands and contracts with temperature, forcing horizontal displacement at the pier heads, which would create large moments in a very stiff pier. The designers split the upper part of each pier, about 90 m, into two shafts: acting as a frame they give bending stiffness against unbalanced live load, while each slender shaft follows the deck's thermal movement more gently. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Split upper pier shafts” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：假設梁體以中央 P4 附近為不動點，P1 與 P4 之間為三個主跨，距不動點 3×342 = 1,026 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Assume the deck is fixed near the central pier P4, so P1, three main spans away, lies 3×342 = 1,026 m from it.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「橋墩越粗越剛，多跨斜張橋就越安全。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The thicker and stiffer the piers, the safer a multi-span cable-stayed bridge becomes." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「雙肢橋墩上段」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Split upper pier shafts”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 多跨斜張體系與橋墩勁度
knowledge.text: 一般斜張橋靠錨碇跨把背索固定在地面，塔頂水平位移受控；米約有六個 342 公尺主跨連續排列，中間各塔沒有錨碇跨，活載只放在某一跨時，塔頂會被拉向受載跨，箱梁與橋墩必須提供勁度抵抗這種不對稱變形。另一方面，長 2,460 公尺的連續鋼梁隨溫度伸縮，墩頂被強迫水平位移，若橋墩太剛就會產生很大的彎矩。
knowledge.textEn: A conventional cable-stayed bridge ties its back stays to the ground through anchor spans, limiting tower-top sway; Millau has six 342 m main spans in a row, so the inner pylons have no anchor spans, and live load on one span pulls the pylon tops toward it, requiring the deck and piers to resist this unbalanced deformation. At the same time the 2,460 m continuous steel deck expands and contracts with temperature, forcing horizontal displacement at the pier heads, which would create large moments in a very stiff pier.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：橋墩越粗越剛，多跨斜張橋就越安全。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The thicker and stiffer the piers, the safer a multi-span cable-stayed bridge becomes. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「多跨斜張體系與橋墩勁度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Multi-span stays and pier stiffness" is correct?
options: 橋墩越粗越剛，多跨斜張橋就越安全。
全部改用高強度鋼一定最省錢、最安全。
一般斜張橋靠錨碇跨把背索固定在地面，塔頂水平位移受控。
optionsEn: The thicker and stiffer the piers, the safer a multi-span cable-stayed bridge becomes.
Using high-strength steel everywhere is always the cheapest and safest choice.
A conventional cable-stayed bridge ties its back stays to the ground through anchor spans, limiting tower-top sway.
quiz.explanation: 一般斜張橋靠錨碇跨把背索固定在地面，塔頂水平位移受控；米約有六個 342 公尺主跨連續排列，中間各塔沒有錨碇跨，活載只放在某一跨時，塔頂會被拉向受載跨，箱梁與橋墩必須提供勁度抵抗這種不對稱變形。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A conventional cable-stayed bridge ties its back stays to the ground through anchor spans, limiting tower-top sway; Millau has six 342 m main spans in a row, so the inner pylons have no anchor spans, and live load on one span pulls the pylon tops toward it, requiring the deck and piers to resist this unbalanced deformation. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 多跨斜張體系與橋墩勁度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Multi-span stays and pier stiffness: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「雙肢橋墩上段」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Split upper pier shafts” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：假設梁體以中央 P4 附近為不動點，P1 與 P4 之間為三個主跨，距不動點 3×342 = 1,026 m。鋼的 α = 1.2×10⁻⁵/°C、溫差 35 °C：墩頂強迫位移 Δ = α·L·ΔT = 1.2×10⁻⁵×1,026×35 ≈ 0.431 m。若把實心墩頭剖成兩片各為一半深度的薄肢，單肢慣性矩為原來的 1/8，兩肢獨立彎曲時合計約 1/4。不動點與溫差為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Assume the deck is fixed near the central pier P4, so P1, three main spans away, lies 3×342 = 1,026 m from it. With steel α = 1.2×10⁻⁵/°C and a 35 °C range, the imposed pier-head movement is Δ = α·L·ΔT = 1.2×10⁻⁵×1,026×35 ≈ 0.431 m. Splitting a solid head into two leaves of half depth gives each leaf 1/8 of the original second moment, about 1/4 for both bending independently. Fixed point and temperature range are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以考慮幾何非線性的全橋模型，分別計算單跨滿載、隔跨滿載與溫度工況下的塔頂位移、墩底彎矩與箱梁應力；施工中以 GNSS 與傾斜儀量測墩頂位移與溫度的關係，與模型預測比對。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use a geometrically nonlinear whole-bridge model to compute pylon-top sway, pier-base moments and deck stresses for one span loaded, alternate spans loaded and temperature cases; during construction measure pier-head movement against temperature with GNSS and inclinometers and compare with predictions.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 假設梁體以中央 P4 附近為不動點，P1 與 P4 之間為三個主跨，距不動點 3×342 = 1,026 m。鋼的 α = 1.2×10⁻⁵/°C、溫差 35 °C：墩頂強迫位移 Δ = α·L·ΔT = 1.2×10⁻⁵×1,026×35 ≈ 0.431 m。若把實心墩頭剖成兩片各為一半深度的薄肢，單肢慣性矩為原來的 1/8，兩肢獨立彎曲時合計約 1/4。不動點與溫差為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Assume the deck is fixed near the central pier P4, so P1, three main spans away, lies 3×342 = 1,026 m from it. With steel α = 1.2×10⁻⁵/°C and a 35 °C range, the imposed pier-head movement is Δ = α·L·ΔT = 1.2×10⁻⁵×1,026×35 ≈ 0.431 m. Splitting a solid head into two leaves of half depth gives each leaf 1/8 of the original second moment, about 1/4 for both bending independently. Fixed point and temperature range are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「多跨斜張體系與橋墩勁度」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Multi-span stays and pier stiffness", which statement holds?
options: 假設梁體以中央 P4 附近為不動點，P1 與 P4 之間為三個主跨，距不動點 3×342 = 1,026 m。
頂推只是把梁往前推，主要風險是推力不夠。
斜索阻尼器越靠近橋面中央越有效，位置不重要。
optionsEn: Assume the deck is fixed near the central pier P4, so P1, three main spans away, lies 3×342 = 1,026 m from it.
Launching is just pushing the deck forward, and the main risk is insufficient push force.
Stay dampers work equally well anywhere, so their position does not matter.
quiz.explanation: 假設梁體以中央 P4 附近為不動點，P1 與 P4 之間為三個主跨，距不動點 3×342 = 1,026 m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Assume the deck is fixed near the central pier P4, so P1, three main spans away, lies 3×342 = 1,026 m from it. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 多跨斜張體系與橋墩勁度：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Multi-span stays and pier stiffness: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「雙肢橋墩上段」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Split upper pier shafts” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以考慮幾何非線性的全橋模型，分別計算單跨滿載、隔跨滿載與溫度工況下的塔頂位移、墩底彎矩與箱梁應力；施工中以 GNSS 與傾斜儀量測墩頂位移與溫度的關係，與模型預測比對。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use a geometrically nonlinear whole-bridge model to compute pylon-top sway, pier-base moments and deck stresses for one span loaded, alternate spans loaded and temperature cases; during construction measure pier-head movement against temperature with GNSS and inclinometers and compare with predictions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：多跨斜張橋的設計基準應明列不對稱活載排列與溫度組合，並把墩、塔、梁的勁度比例當成設計參數做敏感度分析；施工監測計畫須指定墩頂位移的預警值與量測溫度條件。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The design basis for a multi-span cable-stayed bridge should list unbalanced live-load patterns with temperature combinations and treat the pier–pylon–deck stiffness ratio as a parameter in sensitivity studies; the monitoring plan should define pier-head movement alert values and the temperature conditions for measurement.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若橋墩只為溫度變形設計得很柔，不對稱活載下塔頂位移過大、箱梁撓度與彎矩超出容許；若為了勁度做得太剛，溫度伸縮會在墩底產生巨大彎矩與裂縫，兩者都無法單靠加大斷面解決。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Piers made very flexible for thermal movement let pylon tops sway excessively under unbalanced live load, overstressing and over-deflecting the deck; piers made very stiff for live load develop huge base moments and cracks from thermal movement, and neither problem is solved simply by enlarging sections. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以考慮幾何非線性的全橋模型，分別計算單跨滿載、隔跨滿載與溫度工況下的塔頂位移、墩底彎矩與箱梁應力；施工中以 GNSS 與傾斜儀量測墩頂位移與溫度的關係，與模型預測比對。
knowledge.textEn: Use a geometrically nonlinear whole-bridge model to compute pylon-top sway, pier-base moments and deck stresses for one span loaded, alternate spans loaded and temperature cases; during construction measure pier-head movement against temperature with GNSS and inclinometers and compare with predictions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 多跨斜張橋的設計基準應明列不對稱活載排列與溫度組合，並把墩、塔、梁的勁度比例當成設計參數做敏感度分析；施工監測計畫須指定墩頂位移的預警值與量測溫度條件。
knowledge.textEn: The design basis for a multi-span cable-stayed bridge should list unbalanced live-load patterns with temperature combinations and treat the pier–pylon–deck stiffness ratio as a parameter in sensitivity studies; the monitoring plan should define pier-head movement alert values and the temperature conditions for measurement.

quiz.question: 要驗證「多跨斜張體系與橋墩勁度」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Multi-span stays and pier stiffness"?
options: 沿用另一座橋或另一棟建築的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
以考慮幾何非線性的全橋模型，分別計算單跨滿載、隔跨滿載與溫度工況下的塔頂位移、墩底彎矩與箱梁應力。
鋼橋面的疲勞只和鋼材強度有關，鋪面不會影響。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another bridge or building counts as verifying this structure.
Use a geometrically nonlinear whole-bridge model to compute pylon-top sway, pier-base moments and deck stresses for one span loaded, alternate spans loaded and temperature cases.
Steel deck fatigue depends only on steel strength; surfacing has no effect.
quiz.explanation: 以考慮幾何非線性的全橋模型，分別計算單跨滿載、隔跨滿載與溫度工況下的塔頂位移、墩底彎矩與箱梁應力；施工中以 GNSS 與傾斜儀量測墩頂位移與溫度的關係，與模型預測比對。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Use a geometrically nonlinear whole-bridge model to compute pylon-top sway, pier-base moments and deck stresses for one span loaded, alternate spans loaded and temperature cases; during construction measure pier-head movement against temperature with GNSS and inclinometers and compare with predictions. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 多跨斜張體系與橋墩勁度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Multi-span stays and pier stiffness: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「雙肢橋墩上段」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Split upper pier shafts” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若橋墩只為溫度變形設計得很柔，不對稱活載下塔頂位移過大、箱梁撓度與彎矩超出容許；若為了勁度做得太剛，溫度伸縮會在墩底產生巨大彎矩與裂縫，兩者都無法單靠加大斷面解決。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Piers made very flexible for thermal movement let pylon tops sway excessively under unbalanced live load, overstressing and over-deflecting the deck; piers made very stiff for live load develop huge base moments and cracks from thermal movement, and neither problem is solved simply by enlarging sections. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：設計者的解法是讓每座墩在上部約 90 公尺分成兩肢：兩肢組成的框架對不對稱活載提供彎曲勁度，單肢較細又能柔和地跟隨梁體伸縮。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The designers split the upper part of each pier, about 90 m, into two shafts: acting as a frame they give bending stiffness against unbalanced live load, while each slender shaft follows the deck's thermal movement more gently.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「橋墩越粗越剛，多跨斜張橋就越安全。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The thicker and stiffer the piers, the safer a multi-span cable-stayed bridge becomes." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若橋墩只為溫度變形設計得很柔，不對稱活載下塔頂位移過大、箱梁撓度與彎矩超出容許；若為了勁度做得太剛，溫度伸縮會在墩底產生巨大彎矩與裂縫，兩者都無法單靠加大斷面解決。
knowledge.textEn: Piers made very flexible for thermal movement let pylon tops sway excessively under unbalanced live load, overstressing and over-deflecting the deck; piers made very stiff for live load develop huge base moments and cracks from thermal movement, and neither problem is solved simply by enlarging sections.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「多跨斜張體系與橋墩勁度」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Multi-span stays and pier stiffness" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
全部改用高強度鋼一定最省錢、最安全。
若橋墩只為溫度變形設計得很柔，不對稱活載下塔頂位移過大、箱梁撓度與彎矩超出容許。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Using high-strength steel everywhere is always the cheapest and safest choice.
Piers made very flexible for thermal movement let pylon tops sway excessively under unbalanced live load, overstressing and over-deflecting the deck.
quiz.explanation: 若橋墩只為溫度變形設計得很柔，不對稱活載下塔頂位移過大、箱梁撓度與彎矩超出容許；若為了勁度做得太剛，溫度伸縮會在墩底產生巨大彎矩與裂縫，兩者都無法單靠加大斷面解決。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Piers made very flexible for thermal movement let pylon tops sway excessively under unbalanced live load, overstressing and over-deflecting the deck; piers made very stiff for live load develop huge base moments and cracks from thermal movement, and neither problem is solved simply by enlarging sections. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.
